name: Spirit Orb

pages.text: Find in major structure chests or obtain by breaking a spawner. Trade four orbs at a Goddess Statue for an upgrade.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Orbs are added to Stronghold, Bastion, Nether Fortress, Desert Pyramid, Jungle Temple, Ocean Ruin and Buried Treasure chests. Native spawner-breaking rules also supply them. JEM currently enables orb generation.

pages.title: How to obtain
pages.text: Open a supported structure chest. Some chest types always receive one orb and others use a 50% chance. Breaking a spawner is the alternative route. There is no crafting-grid recipe.

pages.title: How to use
pages.text: Find and interact with a Goddess Statue. Four Spirit Orbs buy one Heart Container or Stamina Vessel while the matching upgrade remains available.

jem_summary: Find in major structure chests or obtain by breaking a spawner. Trade four orbs at a Goddess Statue for an upgrade.
